watch_intent: Tell me when any email arrives that mentions a production incident, outage, or service degradation affecting an enterprise customer account.

Tell me when a recruiter or recruiting coordinator sends an email about a candidate in the platform infrastructure or backend engineering pipeline — things like interview scheduling, offer updates, or a candidate declining or dropping out.

Tell me when an email arrives that is directly addressed to me from either jordan.reyes@crestline.io or dana.okafor@crestline.io and is not a calendar invite or an automated system notification — I want to know about any message they write to me personally.
Tell me when an email arrives from a vendor or external software provider that mentions a price increase, contract renewal, end-of-life notice, or a change to terms of service.

Tell me when any email arrives that contains a CI/CD pipeline failure, failed deployment, or build error alert and the email explicitly names at least one of the following services in the subject or body: api-gateway, data-pipeline, infra-core, or deployment-service.
